verdict.rationale: Docs directly describe identity-triggered no-code automation across the hire-to-departure lifecycle: automatic provisioning/deprovisioning on role change or offboarding, dynamic role-based access rules, device lifecycle automation tied to hiring/offboarding, and offboarding-triggered inventory retrieval flows. This spans app access, devices, and inventory choreography without requiring custom code. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of end-to-end reliability across many apps and no detail on how granular no-code rule building actually is in the UI.
